content: Yusup hyalli re rla' nan re'eni wornu la Mesira
Mere lar de lawan rehi ma'ta.
Pede la'pa metam maka ha rodia la Mesir de ra'ana pa nhorwua, dewade amni nakot la re: “A'nami re, mlia miweli owa'ana yamanna oke'a mai ita.”
Noka Yehuda nwahla: “Ama, riy de nwagahniort ami niwra: “Miy di yana mimkek a ga'yu, la'pa garmi de edon nor rewre'wa miy talla.”
Hade pede la'pa omuala gar miamni pa nor amtialla, de ampayow pa amla' hande ne amaweli yamanan tiy o'a.
Mere la'pa omuhmena mhuria pa nla'a, de am miana amahmena mla' hande, yoma riy de nakot olek la ami de: “Miy di yan mimkeka a ga'yu la'pa garmi de edon nor rewre'wa miy talla.””
Noka Yakopa niwra: “A'na miy re, nihya'pa miy miala wniarora-wnialai liawna mai a'u, onnila mikot la riy de, de garmi ida edama?”

Rwahla riwra: “Yoma riy de natiana plu'wu-plehu ami la'a a inon mamni me a am mamni-hyali miamni, lup muamni-rom mamni, de natiana emkadi mai am die niwra: “Ammi nmormior mia'ta? Garmi erla?” Ne amakot momuou oleka honona la emeka plollolli. Emkameni pa amla mparor nana de, pena nhopan pa amodia gar mamni de pa mla e'a?”
Noka Yehuda nakot la amni niwra: “Ame, muolin doin tuwgar die pa nor a' tialla, totpa ampahi'a-ampayod pia mla'awa, totpa tmormiori aplahwa, yana it hononita tmati.
A'g ed mak kakwar hade, la' pena mtio'ona hade mai a'u, la'pa a'g edon godia hade tiy o'a me awuagamtatna la gaimu ralamni, de a'g ed mak khi' do'a-kyap hial tiy o'a pa nodi liarni.
La'pa it edon palo'on it mana, it talanni re'eni worg olekwa.”

Noka amni nakot la re: “La'pa hade emkade de, mhi' emkadi: Mia'ala noh di wullu-we'elli mak samomuou muemna la'a kadmi ralamni, ne miodia la riy de emeka limtutmi. Miala ortawi-autiawi oke'a pa rala ratiaka mehrani, me oke'a mak huwnu mikmikri, me gani oke'a, na'itra duhru-lawruru wo'oni.
Ne miod kupna, mi'itar la pa liawanni re'eni woru. Kupan maka npolla la kadmi nurnu re, miodi owa'ana pa miwali, yanhi'pa nhiortaplin tio'a.
Miod wialia garmi de, pa plet pa miwal lia riy de.

Awuakwak de, Uplerlawna mak kodi plolli-ktaryatnu Nhi'a riy de ralamni pa nakwali, totpa ralam kalwiedwedni tiy miy, demade nolin doini hyalmi handin de nora Benyamina pa rawali. Mere la'pa rmol wua de, ah! Ariorta'ru olek hadewa.”
Noka Yakop a'nani re ra'ala limtutnu rena, me kupna liawanni re'eni woru ralamni, na'itar wutu Benyamin wali pa rla'awa Mesir wa. La' noka rla rtutrier lia Yusup gaini ralamni.

La'pa Yusup namkek nana Benyamina nora re talla, noka nakot la mak khi' o'ta la e romni niwra: “Muodia riy ri, pa mlia'awa a ro'mu nayanni, mriotna nhiuri-wnia'ana id pa mpuahi' targa, yoma riy ri hota ror pa ma'an rewre'wa la lera pniahnani di.”
Riy de nhi' emolmolla maka Yusup nakot targa la, de nodia riy re rla'awa Yusup romni nayanni.

Noka riy re ramta'at wenna, yoma rodia pa rla'awa Yusup romni nayanni. Riwra: “Mak katota-kariei pia rod it la handi, de la' kupan maka ha rpolla la'a it kadnu la ululu de. Rod it mai handi totpa rtorn ita pa rhi' it la ata-wa'ara, me it keledaini re mana ra'ala.”
Hade pede rrehgoru mak khi' o'tani la Yusup romni. Riy de etla romni de nhiarni gaini, noma rakot la:
“Ampak pa maltieri matroma. Am di ululu de ma mawelia yamanna.

Mere la'pa am mte'ela gen miaka amanin la, ne am mpe'era kadu muamni nurnu, de mamkek nana rima-rima kupanni erla kadu nurnu de edonna npa'eini-npahala la maka ampairi oleka. Mere dodo'ondi amodia pa mawal wia.
Kupna handina re mana amod wialia pa ralla rawel yamanna, amaplin niohora he' ed mak kenia kupna rella a kad muamni.”

Mere nwahla niwra: “Mmiolmiolmi, yan mimta'ata, mak kla' Uplerlawna la miy miora ammi, Nal oleka tiy miy re'a-tniaru mak kdella kadmi ralamni, kupanmi re aliernan oleka la dodo'ona.” Raltieri pia nhorwua noka nalgota Simeon pa nod wutga rla.
La'pa riy de nodia rpa rla'awa Yusup romni nayanni, dewade nala gera pa ralla rohma lakni, ne keledaini re mana ralla ra'an wali.
Nhor nioka rwahi' targa limtutnu re, rweiya Yusup nmai lia lera pniahnani, yoma ratlin nan oleka de hota ra'an la hande.
La'pa Yusup npolan wa dewade rala limtutnu re rella Yusup la'a roma nayanni, noka rwaltiora-rwaltieman la.
Nhor nioka natiana re niwra: “Miy e mkialwiedweda? Emkameni la ammi de e nkalwiedwed pa edama?”
Rwahla riwra: “Matroma, atmu de, e nkalwiedweda.” Nhor nioka ruh' idma-rrama lia'ar la Yusup wa.

La'pa Yusup nakillia de, namkek nana garni Benyamina maka rrora inni ida, noka niwra: “Hadi de gari hoho'omi maka ha mikotkota mai a'u hadina?” Noka lirni la Benyamina niwra: “Awuakwak de Uplerlawna Nala ra'ani-pallu tiy o'a ama!”
Noka plet pa Yusup nwaran la hande, yoma ralamni nmawal doin la, onnila ralamni nmayo'odoin la garni. Noma nahak gen pia la nkakur la. Noka nla'awa rialam la kamri pa nko'a-nkakur la hande.
Nhor nioka nla narar gaini noka nlergot wa. Natahan ralamni na'nama niwra: “Mhioi-mtian lia mei wawannu.”

Noka rkenia Yusup ya'ana-yemannu la' genni ida, ne la'a hyalli re mana rwamueh' geni, ne makden Mesir mak ka'an rewre'wa re mana rwamueh' geni. Yoma makden Mesir re yana ra'an wut lia makden Ibrani, yoma yehwa mak emkade makden Mesir makriarni.
Yusup nhopan pa hyalli re ramtatna la Yusup gaini ralamni, ntawua yanulu pa nodia pa ntut lia gari, nhi'nande idma ramkek la id de ema rtaplelleltarga.

Noka ra'ala ya'ana-yemun mak kdella Yusup meini wawannu pa rkenia la hare meini wawannu. Mere maka Benyamina nlernana rde liawanni narehi re'eni wolim ralamni la hyalli re. Noka ra'an wutu-remun wut lia e'a, me ramuki-rahepur wut rewre'wa la.
